About.title: Who Are We?
About.subtitle: EPUC Nkoabang — a family in faith, driven by the Spirit, rooted in the Word.
About.founded: Founded in the love of Christ
About.vision_desc: Our vision is to be a beacon of Pentecostal revival — where the Word is preached uncompromised, the Holy Spirit honored, and every member equipped to serve.
About.verse_text: "And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it."
About.mission_text: The mission of the United Pentecostal Church of Cameroon is to keep the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, proclaim salvation in His name to all men and minister to the needs of His body, the church.
About.doctrine_text: We remain faithful to apostolic doctrine: the Bible is our only authority in matters of faith and practice. We worship the one true God, recognize Jesus as God manifest in the flesh, preach salvation in His name and adhere to the Apostle's Doctrine.
About.location_card_desc:
Nkoabang — School Entrance
Before the 10th stop from Biteng
About.pillars_desc: EPUC's doctrine is founded on the Bible and faithful to apostolic Pentecostal teaching.
About.v1_desc: One God, fully revealed in Jesus Christ (Deuteronomy 6:4; Colossians 2:9).
About.v2_desc: Baptism by immersion in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins (Acts 2:38).
About.v3_desc: Every believer can receive the Holy Spirit with the initial sign of speaking in tongues (Acts 2:1-4).
About.v4_desc: Living a holy life, set apart from the world (Hebrews 12:14; 1 Peter 1:16).
About.v5_desc: Bringing the Gospel to every creature in Nkoabang and beyond (Matthew 28:19-20).
About.v6_desc: A family united by God's love, mutual aid and communion.
About.v7_desc: Prayer is the oxygen of our church. Fasting and intercession are our pillars.
About.v8_desc: We believe in miracles and divine healing today (James 5:14-15).
About.team_desc: Men and women called by God to lead His flock in Nkoabang.
About.pastor1_desc: Called by God to lead the Nkoabang assembly with the anointing of the Spirit. He preaches the Word without compromise.
About.pastor2_desc: Servants who support the shepherd in spiritual leadership and evangelism.
About.pastor3_desc: Consecrated women who oversee the women's department and intercession.
About.t1_event: Assembly founded in Nkoabang — a few faithful gathered in faith
About.t2_event: First baptisms, first miraculous healings and assembly growth
About.t3_event: Acquisition of permanent place of worship at the school entrance, Nkoabang
About.t4_event: Official temple inauguration and multiplication of departments
About.t5_event: Over 200 active members — the revival continues in Nkoabang!
About.cta_desc: Every Sunday at 9:00 AM, the doors of EPUC Nkoabang are open. Come as you are.

Network.title: Our Church Network
Network.subtitle: The United Pentecostal Church International of Cameroon — one faith, one Spirit, one Lord across the nation.
Network.intro_text: The United Pentecostal Church of Cameroon (UPCI CMR) is a Oneness Apostolic Christ-centered church, practicing faith in the infallible Word of God, propagating Bible salvation and ministering to the needs of all people. Our churches are spread across the major cities of Cameroon.
Network.mission_text: The mission of the United Pentecostal Church of Cameroon is to keep the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, proclaim salvation in His name to all men and minister to the needs of His body, the church.
Network.v1: We worship the one true God
Network.v2: We recognize Jesus as God manifest in the flesh
Network.v3: We preach salvation in the name of Jesus
Network.v4: We adhere to the Apostle's Doctrine
Network.v7: We baptize in water in Jesus' name
Network.v8: We receive the Holy Ghost speaking in other tongues
Network.v9: We live holy as is pleasing to God
Network.v10: We bear the fruit of the Spirit
Network.v14: We look for the imminent return of Christ for His saints
Network.d1: We preach the Gospel in all the world
Network.d5: We operate Spiritual Gifts as God enables
Network.d6: We offer thanksgiving, praise, prayer and intercession to God
Network.d7: We worship in the beauty of holiness
Network.geo_title: Find an UPCI Church Near You
Network.geo_subtitle: Our assemblies are primarily located in Yaoundé, Douala, Buea and Bamenda.
Network.policy_intro: In order to maintain uniformity and holiness in our clothing before God and before men, the District Board of the United Pentecostal Church of Cameroon calls for modesty not only in our inward attitude but also in our outward appearance.
Network.policy_w1: Modest skirts — long enough to cover the knees
Network.policy_w2: No see-through, tight or revealing clothing
Network.policy_w3: No trousers, earrings, necklaces or chains on platform
Network.policy_w4: No artificial hair, wigs, hair dyeing or artificial nails
Network.policy_w5: Wedding rings allowed for heterosexual couples only
Network.policy_m1: Long-sleeve shirt, tie, suit or African wear
Network.policy_m2: No hats, long hair or Rasta locks on the altar
Network.policy_m3: No sleeveless shirts or T-shirts (unless uniform)
Network.policy_m4: No low-waist trousers, shorts or sportswear on platform
Network.policy_m5: Clean-shaved — no beard or moustache strongly encouraged
Network.cta_desc: Every Sunday, the doors of our Nkoabang assembly are open. Come as you are — experience the power of the Holy Spirit.
